statement:
Security: user comments rendered with docpipe can contain clickable script links. >>> from docpipe import render >>> render("[click me](javascript:alert(document.cookie))\n") '

click me

' We render untrusted user documents with the default options. An untrusted document must never produce a dangerous link (see the project's security notes). The tests under `tests/` are owned by QA and are read-only; do not modify them. Make sure the existing test suite still passes.
notes: visit_link writes any href. The documented policy: only relative, http, https and mailto targets become links; schemes case-insensitive with whitespace/control characters ignored; unsafe links render as their text; safe_links=False opts out. ANALYSIS ONLY: never shown to agents.
